steps.title: The tone stage is a curve you drag
steps.body: Three nodes: a low shelf, a mid bell, a high shelf. Drag for gain and frequency, Alt-drag or scroll the mid node for Q, double-click to reset.

steps.title: It only affects its own band
steps.body: The curve fades outside the band's frequency range because that is the only range it touches, and the nodes are clamped to it for the same reason.

steps.title: PRE and POST are different instruments
steps.body: Post-EQ shapes what came out of the saturator. Pre-EQ changes what goes in, and therefore which harmonics get generated at all. Boosting 3 kHz before a tube stage is not the same as boosting it after.

steps.title: See every band's curve at once
steps.body: Switch the display to EQ or Both. Each band's curve appears in its own region and the nodes are draggable there too.

steps.title: The combined response
steps.body: The thicker line is every band's curve weighted by how much signal that band is actually carrying. A band with nothing in it does not bend the line, however its curve is set.
